units.locator: Article 32. Registers of state civil servants
units.text: 6. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 32

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: Article 33. Personnel work
units.label: Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 1. Personnel work shall include:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 1) forming the personnel complement to fill civil service positions, including recruiting and attracting personnel, assessing the professional level of applicants for civil service positions and checking compliance with the qualification requirements for such positions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 2) preparing proposals for implementing the provisions of federal laws, this Law and other regulatory legal acts on the civil service, and submitting those proposals to the employer’s representative;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 3) organizing the drafting of acts of the state body and formalizing its decisions connected with entry into, performance of and termination of the civil service, including conclusion of service contracts, appointment to civil service positions, nomination for civil service incentives and awards, imposition of disciplinary sanctions, release from civil service positions held, dismissal from the civil service and retirement on a length-of-service pension; 4) maintaining civil servants’ employment record books (where available), compiling employment activity information for their period of civil service, and submitting that information, in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on individual (personalized) record-keeping in the compulsory pension insurance system, for storage in the information resources of the Pension and Social Insurance Fund of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 5) maintaining civil servants' personal files;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 6) maintaining the state body’s register of state civil servants;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 7) preparing and issuing civil servants' official identity cards;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 8) supporting the work of the conflict-of-interest resolution commission;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 9) organizing and supporting competitions to fill civil service positions and to include civil servants and citizens in the personnel reserve;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 10) organizing and supporting the appraisal of civil servants (hereinafter also referred to as appraisal);
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 11) this point was repealed with effect from 29 April 2023 by Law of the City of Moscow of 19 April 2023 No. 10,;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 12) organizing the conclusion of targeted education agreements;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 13) organizing civil servants’ professional education;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 14) forming the personnel reserve, organizing work with it and ensuring its effective use;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 15) supporting civil servants' career advancement;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 16) organizing and conducting checks of information submitted by a citizen upon entry into the civil service and during their service as a civil servant; 16.1) arranging clearance in the prescribed form for access to state secrets;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 17) organizing internal service inquiries;
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 18) organizing verification of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and of civil servants’ compliance with restrictions established by federal laws;
units.label: Point 18 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 19) advising civil servants on legal and other civil service matters;
units.label: Point 19 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 20) providing the state service management body with information on all areas of personnel work in accordance with the procedure established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 20 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 21) performing other tasks in accordance with the Model Regulation on a State Body’s Structural Subdivision for State Service and Personnel Matters.
units.label: Point 21 Part 1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 1.1. Personnel work uses the City of Moscow’s state information system in the field of civil service, which must be compatible with the federal state information system in the field of state service and comply with the uniform requirements for the volume and content of information on the staffing of state bodies that is to be stored, processed and transmitted electronically.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 2. Personnel work in a state body is carried out by a structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters whose activities are directly supervised and coordinated by the employer’s representative, or by a specially authorized civil servant directly subordinate to the employer’s representative.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 3. Appointment to and release from civil service positions of heads of structural subdivisions for state service and personnel matters and of specially authorized civil servants, and the imposition of disciplinary sanctions on them, are carried out in accordance with the established procedure in agreement with the state service management body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 4. The Model Regulation on a State Body’s Structural Subdivision for State Service and Personnel Matters is approved by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 5. The regulation on a state body’s structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters is approved by the head of the state body.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 33

units.locator: Article 33. Personnel work
units.text: 6. A structural subdivision for state service and personnel matters may not be assigned additional functions not provided for by this Law and the relevant decree of the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 33

units.locator: Chapter 7. Service time and rest time. Leave in the civil service
units.text: Chapter 7. Service time and rest time. Leave in the civil service
units.label: Chapter 7. Service time and rest time. Leave in the civil service

units.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time
units.text: Article 34. Service time and rest time
units.label: Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time
units.text: 1. Service time is the time during which a civil servant must perform official duties in accordance with the state body’s service rules, the service schedule or the terms of the service contract, and other periods classified as service time by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time
units.text: 2. The normal duration of service time for a civil servant may not exceed 40 hours per week. A five-day service week shall be established for civil servants.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time
units.text: 3. An irregular service day is established for civil servants holding the highest and principal civil service positions.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time
units.text: 4. For civil servants holding positions in other groups, an irregular service day is established in accordance with the list of civil service positions subject to an irregular service day established by the state body’s service rules or the service contract.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 34. Service time and rest time
units.text: 5. The right to rest is realized by providing a civil servant with time free from the performance of official duties (free time) outside the normal duration of service time established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 34

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.label: Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 1. A civil servant shall be granted annual leave with retention of the civil service position held and monetary remuneration.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 2. A civil servant's annual paid leave shall consist of basic paid leave and additional paid leave.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 3. Civil servants shall be granted basic annual paid leave of 30 calendar days.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 4. Civil servants shall be granted additional annual paid leave for length of service of the following duration:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 1) for civil service length from 1 year to 5 years — 1 calendar day;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 2) for civil service length from 5 to 10 years — 5 calendar days;
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 3) for civil service length from 10 to 15 years — 7 calendar days;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 4) for civil service length of 15 years or more — 10 calendar days.
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 5. This part was repealed with effect from 21 October 2016 by Law of the City of Moscow of 28 September 2016 No. 32
units.label: Part 5 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 6. Civil servants subject to an irregular service day shall be granted additional annual paid leave for irregular service days of three calendar days.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 7. This part was repealed with effect from 21 October 2016 by Law of the City of Moscow of 28 September 2016 No. 32
units.label: Part 7 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 8. Additional leave for civil servants subject to an irregular service day, and in other cases provided for by federal laws, is granted in addition to the combined basic annual paid leave and additional annual paid leave for length of service.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 9. This part was repealed with effect from 16 April 2016 by Law of the City of Moscow of 23 March 2016 No. 11.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 10. A civil servant must be granted annual paid leave each year in accordance with a leave schedule approved by the employer’s representative no later than two weeks before the start of the calendar year.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 10.1. The minimum duration of annual paid leave taken by a civil servant in the service year for which it is granted may not be less than 28 calendar days. At least one portion of the annual paid leave must be at least 14 calendar days.
units.label: Part 10.1 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 10.2. In exceptional cases, where granting a civil servant annual paid leave in the current service year for the total duration calculated in accordance with parts 3 and 4 of this Article may adversely affect the performance of the state body’s tasks and functions or the exercise of powers by a person holding a state office of the City of Moscow, the portion of annual paid leave exceeding 28 calendar days may, by decision of the employer’s representative and with the civil servant’s written consent, be carried over to the next service year. The portion carried over must be used no later than 12 months after the end of the service year for which it was granted.
units.label: Part 10.2 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 10.3. The portion of annual paid leave exceeding 28 calendar days, or any number of days from that portion, may be replaced by monetary compensation upon the civil servant's written application.
units.label: Part 10.3 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.label: Part 10.3 Art. 35 · “11)”

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 11. A civil servant's monetary remuneration for the period of annual paid leave must be paid no later than 10 calendar days before the leave begins.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 12. When a civil servant is granted annual paid leave, regardless of its duration, a lump-sum payment equal to two monthly remuneration salaries is made once a year.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 13. It is prohibited to deny civil servants annual paid leave for two consecutive years.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 14. Upon termination or cancellation of a service contract, release from the civil service position held and dismissal from civil service, the civil servant shall be paid monetary compensation for all unused leave. Upon the civil servant's written application, unused leave may be granted followed by dismissal (except where release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service are due to culpable acts). In that case, the last day of leave shall be considered the date of release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 15. In the event of dismissal due to expiry of the service contract, leave followed by dismissal may also be granted where the leave falls wholly or partly beyond the term of the service contract. In that case, the last day of leave shall likewise be considered the date of release from the civil service position and dismissal from civil service.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 16. For family circumstances or other valid reasons, a civil servant may, upon their written application and by decision of the employer's representative, be granted leave without monetary remuneration for no more than one year. A civil servant shall also be granted leave without monetary remuneration in other cases provided for by federal laws.
units.label: Part 16 Art. 35

units.locator: Article 35. Leave in the civil service
units.text: 17. During leave without monetary remuneration, the civil servant shall retain the civil service position held.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 35
